name: ChatGPT Prompts + AI Automation Toolkit — 20 Business Prompts, No-Code Guide & Scripts
description:
Stop reading about AI — start automating today. This no-code toolkit gives you 10 copy-paste AI workflows, 2 ready-to-run Google Apps Script tools, 20 business prompts (CSV), and templates that cut 20+ hours/month of repetitive work. Built for solopreneurs, freelancers, and small teams. No coding required.

What's inside:
• 10 workflows — email replies, meeting notes → minutes + tasks, spreadsheet cleanup, batch copy, invoices, prompt library, AI compliance check, bulk processing, auto reports, and building your own tools.
• 2 working Google Apps Script tools — bulk-process a sheet column with AI; send an automated daily summary email.
• 20 business prompts (CSV) — import straight into Sheets or Notion.
• Invoice template + a safety checklist + free updates.

You'll need: ChatGPT or Claude (free tier works) + Google Sheets. Some scripts use a cheap pay-as-you-go OpenAI API key.

Instant download — you get the ZIP immediately after purchase. Digital product, so no refunds after download. Questions? Message me any time.

Note: This toolkit's contents were created with the help of AI. It is an original compiled product, not resold or drop-shipped.
currency_note: Same first-sale-band pricing rationale as the Etsy listing ($9, impulse band for a zero-review new seller). The API takes price_currency_type; verify against the account's actual settlement currency before the first real run if the account is JPY-denominated.
